about: Every browser-lab result that is not PASS must match an entry here, or the run fails as UNCLASSIFIED. Kinds: 'app-finding' = a genuine application defect, which still fails the run unless the product owner records ownerAccepted: true (with name and date in ownerAcceptance); 'live-not-supported' = a fixture scenario the live UI does not offer by design, so the browser path cannot reproduce it (covered by the engine path instead). An entry that matches nothing in a run fails the run as STALE, so a fixed defect must be removed from this register. Expected values are never edited to match the app. Protected by the test-integrity guard.

findings.title: HT and FT snapshot pages draw the STATISTICS badge over the PáircVision wordmark
findings.where: src/stats/reviewPdfExport.ts:13831 — snapshot pages call stampLayerBadge(canvas, layer) with the default 'stacked' placement; the Full Review uses 'inline' placement, whose comment (line 6740) says the stacked placement overlapped the wordmark.
findings.evidence: Rendered PDF page 1 of every HT and FT snapshot (matches A, B, C, D): the italic 'PáircVision' wordmark is drawn underneath the STATISTICS chip at the top right. Statistics are unaffected.

findings.title: Quick Review counts show a 'Sin Bins' row (always 0) for hurling, which has no sin-bin sanction in the app
findings.where: src/pro-tagger/ProTaggerLiveScreen.tsx:1745 — the counts rows are not sport-filtered; getDisciplineOptions('hurling') has no SIN_BIN (src/pro-tagger/pro-tagger-discipline.test.ts:39).
findings.evidence: Match C and D Quick Review page 2 at HT and FT: row ['0', 'Sin Bins', '0'].

findings.title: Hurling Full Review Match Summary labels a puckout outcome 'Kicked Dead'
findings.where: src/stats/reviewPdfExport.ts:3345 and :3365 — the restart column row label is not sport-aware (the section heading correctly reads PUCKOUTS).
findings.evidence: Match C and D Full Review page 1: 'Kicked Dead' under PUCKOUTS for both teams (2 occurrences).

findings.title: Match D: a player of the team that LOST a restart (D-005 home #1, D-029 away #1)
findings.where: Live player picker: on a lost restart it offers only the winning team's squad (observed: 'player picker does not offer D Home 1 (#1); offered: D Away 1').
findings.evidence: Match D represents legacy events corrected in Review (PROVENANCE.md). The browser run tags these two events with no player (UNSUPPORTED_PLAYER=unknown) and records it; the engine path verifies the expected 'restarts lost' for both players.
